mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(funds_investment_balance), 0) from bus_rel_funds a join (select rel_identify_number, max(created_time_) as "created_time_" from bus_rel_funds where delflag_ !='0' and status = '1' group by rel_identify_number ) b on a.created_time_ = b.created_time_

SELECT ifnull(sum(ifnull(funds_investment_balance,0)),0) FROM ( select funds_investment_balance from bus_rel_funds where rel_identify_number =
(select unisc_code from bus_rel_org where pid = #{relId})
(select identify_number from bus_rel_psn where pid = #{relId})
order by created_time_ desc limit 1 ) a

select * from (select * from bus_rel_funds where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-01-01 00:00:00') and CONCAT(#{year},'-03-31 23:59:59') order by investment_balance_time ) b union ALL select * from (select * from bus_rel_funds where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-04-01 00:00:00' )and CONCAT(#{year},'-06-30 23:59:59') order by investment_balance_time ) b union ALL select * from (select * from bus_rel_funds where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-07-01 00:00:00') and CONCAT(#{year},'-09-30 23:59:59') order by investment_balance_time ) b union all select * from (select * from bus_rel_funds where investment_balance_time between CONCAT(#{year},'-10-01 00:00:00') and CONCAT(#{year},'-12-31 23:59:59') order by investment_balance_time ) b
SELECT * FROM bus_rel_funds WHERE delflag_ = '1' AND investment_balance_time >= #{startTime} AND investment_balance_time <= #{endTime} AND rel_identify_number = #{relNumber}
select * from bus_rel_funds where DELFLAG_ = '1' and DATE_FORMAT(investment_balance_time, '%Y-%m-%d') between #{quarterBeginDate} and #{quarterEndDate} order by investment_balance_time desc limit 1
